_comment: sections only the GSU reads: window B (file $400000-$5FFFFF, GSU banks $40-$5F); every other section goes to window A (LoROM, CPU and GSU).  Glob patterns.
_comment2: level parts: *_A (BSP, areas, vertexes, segs, faces), *_J (REJECT in ROM); *_R (the level RAM image, copied to GSU RAM $71 by the GSU) is either: window B, or window A when B is full
